question: What is the source claimed for the speaker's knowledge of the determination of the Kaula teaching?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker claims to have come to know something.
That knowledge is attributed to the grace of the one addressed.
inference: By the grace of the lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
uncertainties: The full content of that determination is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
